## Where I am

The postgres 17 blue/green change for the analytics RDS is in draft PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57. Staging is prepared: the parameter group family is derived from the major version, blue/green is enabled, and the AWS provider is pinned to ~> 5.82.0 (no v6 in this PR). Prod is prepared but disabled behind `pg17_enabled = false`, with `apply_immediately = false`. Nothing has been applied. The only database access was a read-only check of staging extensions.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #57 is open. Staging plan shows 1 to add and 1 to change; prod plan shows no changes.
- [prochaine-étape] Upgrade pg_partman from 4.7.4 to 5.1.0 on staging (ALTER EXTENSION on 16.4), then check `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw` and `events_daily`. This must happen before the staging blue/green apply, otherwise the green environment will not be created.
- [prochaine-étape] Pick the prod window after Maya signs off. It must avoid the nightly dbt lock on `events_daily` (01:00–03:30 UTC). Saturday 04:00–06:00 UTC and Sunday 04:00–06:00 UTC are the lowest-traffic slots outside the lock.
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` failed on the lock file. Upgrading the provider to v6 produced 37 unrelated changes (S3 ACL, `aws_eip.vpc` removed), so the pin was set back to 5.82.
- [essai-raté] `tflint` flagged an unused `snapshot_identifier` variable and a missing version constraint for the `random` provider. Both were fixed in `c58e1fa`.
- [question] Maya's sign-off on the whole change is still pending before any prod date is set.
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off, and `apply_immediately` stays `false` on prod. (source: t14)
- [décision] Do not run anything against the database beyond read-only checks, and treat the pg_partman upgrade as a separate step. (source: t10)
